## Scope

## Acceptance criteria

## Data, source, and privacy impact

- [ ] No new personal data is collected or shared.
- [ ] Official-source provenance and evidence rules are preserved.
- [ ] No secrets, subscriber data, or private dashboard data are included in logs/artifacts.
- [ ] Any changed data lifecycle or consent requirement is documented.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant focused tests pass.
- [ ] Relevant broader test suite passes.
- [ ] Regression and failure-path coverage is included where needed.
- [ ] Independent review has checked assumptions, diff, and test coverage.
